terms.title: Terms of service
terms.lede: The agreement between you and {{brand}}. A draft: the owner finalizes it with legal help before launch.

what.heading: 1. What {{brand}} is
what.p1: {{brand}} is a self-assessment and practice tool for job seekers, operated by {{entity}}. You upload your own CV and a job posting you are interested in; the service compares the two and gives you feedback. You can then practice an interview for that posting out loud with an AI voice interviewer and receive feedback on your answers.
what.p2: {{brand}} is for you, about your own application. It is not a tool for companies to assess or rank people, no one else sees your results, and the voice interviewer is software, never a person.

account.heading: 2. Your account
account.p1: You need an account to use the service. Keep your sign-in method to yourself; what happens under your account is yours. You must be able to enter into a contract where you live to use a paid plan.

plans.heading: 3. Plans, prices and billing
plans.p1: Free includes {{freeAnalyses}} CV checks per month, one {{trialMinutes}}-minute practice interview, and your last {{freeHistory}} analyses. Pro is a monthly subscription that includes unlimited CV checks (subject to fair use), {{proInterviews}} practice interviews per billing period of up to {{fullMinutes}} minutes each, and your full history. Interview packs add {{packCredits}} practice interviews for Pro subscribers; pack credits do not expire and can be used while Pro is active.
plans.p2: Purchases are made through {{merchant}}, the merchant of record. {{merchant}} handles the payment, the invoice, applicable taxes and refunds, and appears on your statement. Prices are shown before you pay. A subscription renews each period until you cancel it; you can cancel at any time from your account page, and Pro stays active until the end of the period you paid for.

fairUse.heading: 4. Fair use
fairUse.p1: Pro's CV checks are unlimited for a person checking their own applications. We may limit accounts that automate the service, share it between people, or use it for something other than their own job search.

ai.heading: 5. The AI, and its limits
ai.p1: The feedback is generated by AI from the text you provide. It can be wrong, incomplete or inconsistent. It is an aid to your own judgement, not a prediction of how any application will go, and no outcome is promised.

content.heading: 6. Your content
content.p1: Your CV, the postings you paste and your interview answers remain yours. You give us the permission needed to process them to provide the service (see the privacy page). You can delete an analysis, with its interviews, from its page, and your whole account from your profile.

ending.heading: 7. Ending the service
ending.p1: You can stop using {{brand}} at any time. We may suspend an account that breaks these terms. [PLACEHOLDER: notice periods, what happens to paid periods, and the governing law.]

responsible.heading: 1. Who is responsible

collect.heading: 2. What we collect, and why
collect.p1: Everything below exists to give you your own feedback. Nothing is sold, and nothing is used to evaluate you for anyone else.
collect.account: Your account: an identifier and your sign-in details, held by our authentication provider (Clerk). We store the identifier and the interface language you choose, not your email or name.
collect.cv: Your CV: the PDF you upload, kept in private storage so you can reopen it next to its analysis, and its text, which is sent to the AI model that writes the analysis.
collect.postings: The job postings you paste: stored with each analysis and sent to the AI model with your CV's text.
collect.interviews: Your practice interviews: the conversation runs with the AI voice provider (ElevenLabs), which processes your voice and returns a transcript. The transcript is stored with the interview and sent to the AI model that writes the feedback. [PLACEHOLDER: whether audio recordings are retained by the voice provider and for how long.]
collect.translations: Translations: if you use the product in Spanish, the parts of your analyses and interview feedback that the AI model wrote are sent to the AI model to be translated, and the translation is stored with them. Quotes from your CV and the posting, and suggested bullets, are not translated.
collect.usage: Usage: how many analyses and interviews you ran, for your plan's limits.
collect.billing: Billing: if you buy a plan, the payment is handled by the merchant of record ({{merchant}}), which collects your email, country and payment details. We store only its identifiers for your customer and subscription, never a card or an email.

processors.heading: 3. Who processes it
processors.google: Google (Gemini) writes the CV analysis and the interview feedback, and translates them, from the text we send.
processors.elevenlabs: ElevenLabs runs the voice interview and produces the transcript.
processors.supabase: Supabase hosts the database and the private file storage.
processors.merchant: {{merchant}} is the merchant of record for payments.

retention.heading: 4. How long we keep it
retention.p1: A CV lives as long as its analysis. Deleting an analysis deletes the CV, the analysis, its interviews and their feedback, and asks the voice provider to delete the conversations. Deleting your account deletes everything above and cancels any subscription. The merchant of record keeps the records it must keep for tax purposes. [PLACEHOLDER: backup retention windows.]

rights.heading: 5. Your rights
rights.p1: You can see and delete your data from the product itself. For anything else (access, correction, portability, objection, a complaint), write to the contact above. who.heading: 1. Who refunds
who.p1: Every purchase is made through {{merchant}}, the merchant of record. Refunds are issued by {{merchant}} to the payment method you used, under its own buyer terms, and show on your statement from it.

subscriptions.heading: 2. Subscriptions
subscriptions.p1: You can cancel Pro at any time from your account page. Cancelling stops the next charge; Pro stays active until the end of the period you already paid for, and nothing is deleted when it ends. [PLACEHOLDER: whether a refund of the current period is offered, and under what conditions, e.g. within N days of a charge if no interview was run.]

packs.heading: 3. Interview packs
packs.p1: A pack adds {{packCredits}} practice interviews. [PLACEHOLDER: whether unused packs are refundable, within what window.] If a pack is refunded, the credits that were not used are removed; interviews already run are not.

problems.heading: 4. Something went wrong
problems.p1: If a paid interview failed on our side (the interviewer never connected, or the call was lost with no reconnection left), the interview is given back to your plan automatically; you do not need to ask. If something else went wrong with a charge, write to us and we will sort it out with the merchant of record.
